qa_pair.question: On the Avi Controller, the virtual service named 'parent1' is a parent for virtual hosting. How many other virtual services have 'parent1' as their vh_parent_vs_ref (i.e. are its children)?
The virtual service named 'ns1.aws.avilab.eu' load-balances DNS traffic. What single port number is it listening on?
The virtual service named 'parent1' has two service entries, on ports 80 and 443. Which of those two ports has SSL/TLS (enable_ssl) turned on? Answer with just the port number.
Find the backend pool used by the virtual service named 'store'. What load-balancing algorithm (lb_algorithm) is configured on that pool? Give the exact Avi enum value.
Find the backend pool used by the virtual service named 'werpusUS'. How many health monitors are attached to that pool?
The controller has a system health monitor named 'System-Xternal-Perl'. What is its health monitor type (the exact Avi enum value, e.g. HEALTH_MONITOR_HTTP)?
The cloud object named 'Default-Cloud' is backed by which infrastructure provider? Give the exact Avi cloud vtype enum value (e.g. CLOUD_VCENTER, CLOUD_AWS, CLOUD_AZURE).
What is the max_se (maximum number of Service Engines) setting on the Service Engine Group named 'Default-Group'?
Among the backend pools used by the virtual services 'yesserv', 'store', 'werpusUS' and 'vs-sb2', exactly one currently has zero backend servers configured. What is that pool's name?
Three of the controller's virtual services all point at the exact same backend pool (same pool UUID). Name all three virtual services, comma-separated, in alphabetical order.
